# Cristina Andrés — Product, UX/UI & Graphic Designer

> Portfolio of Cristina Andrés, a Spain-based product, UX/UI and graphic designer with a background in industrial design engineering. Selected work for Aqualung, Curefab, Punt, Smurfit Kappa, Montezuma, Ares Domus, Sakana, Ciclogreen and Blossom.

## About

- Name: Cristina Andrés
- Role: Product, UX/UI & Graphic Designer
- Education: Industrial Design Engineering and Product Development, Polytechnical University of Valencia (Spain). Erasmus at He-ARC Neuchâtel (Switzerland) and Hochschule Augsburg (Germany).
- Experience: UX/UI Designer (freelance, since 2023); Graphic Designer at Future Fibres Rigging Systems S.L. (2022).
- Languages: Spanish, Catalan, French, English.
- Skills: UX Design, UI Design, Product Design, Graphic Design, Branding, Packaging Design, Industrial Design Engineering.

## Selected work

- [UI Designs for Aqualung Group](https://cristinadesigns.vercel.app/?project=aqualung): UX/UI design for a diving equipment company (2025).
- [Website for Curefab Technologies GmbH](https://cristinadesigns.vercel.app/?project=curefab): Website design for a German medical-tech company (2024).
- [Product design for Punt](https://cristinadesigns.vercel.app/?project=punt): Design of a wooden sideboard (2023).
- [Montezuma: a new marketing strategy](https://cristinadesigns.vercel.app/?project=montezuma): Marketing strategy and packaging design (2022).
- [Packaging design for Smurfit Kappa](https://cristinadesigns.vercel.app/?project=smurfit%20kappa): Packaging design for bulk products (2022).
- [Design of an amazing brand — Ares Domus](https://cristinadesigns.vercel.app/?project=ares%20domus): Brand design concept for a luxury resort (2022).
- [Design for a Swiss watch — Sakana](https://cristinadesigns.vercel.app/?project=sakana): Product design of a Swiss watch (2022).
- [Project Ciclogreen](https://cristinadesigns.vercel.app/?project=ciclogreen): Indoor growing system (2021).
- [Blossom](https://cristinadesigns.vercel.app/?project=blossom): Flower-shaped lamp with articulated petals (2020).
